intro.text: A soldier and guard in Straff Venture's army.

items.text: As door guard of Straff's tent in the camp outside Luthadel, he fetched Amaranta when Straff believed himself poisoned, and was there when Straff woke, reporting on Lord Janarle and the koloss army. Knowing nothing of Zane's betrayal, he was shocked when Straff chose to retreat instead of attacking the weakened city.
